name: Ozzienet
summary: Wholesale + retail internet access provider ('become your own ISP', ~2001, trading as OzzieNet, Bunbury); acquired by Datafast Telecommunications in Jun 2004 (renamed Eftel 2005) (OZGLOBAL COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD (FORMERLY OZZIENET PTY LTD), ACN 097 460 930).

events.details: Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications / Eftel — acquired by Datafast.

refs.label: Wikipedia: Eftel — Datafast acquisitions (incl. Jun 2004 OzzieNet)
Brand still on the domain in Jul 2005, so the visible site outlived the acquisition.
